Bernardo Silva.note: Watch Silva for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Bernardo Silva.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Bruno Fernandes.note: Fernandes's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Bruno Fernandes.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Cristiano Ronaldo.note: Ronaldo's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Cristiano Ronaldo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Diogo Costa.note: Costa stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Diogo Costa.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Diogo Dalot.note: Dalot is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Diogo Dalot.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Francisco Conceicao.note: Conceição is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Francisco Conceicao.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Francisco Trincao.note: Watch Trincão for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Francisco Trincao.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Goncalo Guedes.note: Watch Guedes for explosive speed once open grass appears. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Goncalo Guedes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Goncalo Inacio.note: Watch Inácio for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Goncalo Inacio.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Goncalo Ramos.note: Ramos is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Goncalo Ramos.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Joao Cancelo.note: Cancelo stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Joao Cancelo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Joao Felix.note: Watch Félix for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Joao Felix.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Joao Neves.note: Neves's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Joao Neves.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Jose Sa.note: Watch Sá for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Jose Sa.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Matheus Nunes.note: Watch Nunes for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Matheus Nunes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Nelson Semedo.note: Semedo's edge is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Nelson Semedo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Nuno Mendes.note: Watch Mendes for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Nuno Mendes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Pedro Neto.note: Watch Neto for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Pedro Neto.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Renato Veiga.note: Veiga is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Renato Veiga.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ruben Dias.note: Dias is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ruben Dias.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ruben Neves.note: Neves stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ruben Neves.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Rui Silva.note: Silva's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Rui Silva.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Samu Costa.note: Costa stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Samu Costa.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tomas Araujo.note: Araújo is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Tomas Araujo.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Vitinha.note: Vitinha stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Vitinha.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。
